title: Chad National Day
author: Marco Rubio, Secretary of State
summary:
Marco Rubio, Secretary of State

Chad National Day

Press Statement

August 11, 2026

On behalf of the United States of America, I extend my warmest congratulations to President Marshal Mahamat Idriss Deby Itno and the people of the Republic of Chad as you celebrate the 66th anniversary of your nation’s independence on August 11.

We honor the enduring partnership and mutual respect between our two countries. The United States remains steadfast in its commitment to strengthening our bilateral ties and working together to advance our mutual goals in supporting regional security, economic prosperity, and the well-being of our citizens.
